description: Get an API key for your user without them pasting one: send what they want and why. With their email you get api_key back at once, a starter key with 250 credits. Show them approval_url and the code; when they approve in the browser (creating a free account if needed) the same key moves to the free plan. Then call finish_signup. Ask your user rather than guess.

data_wanted.description: What SAM.gov or contracting data they want, 3 to 1000 characters.

email.description: Your user's email, for an instant starter key. Optional.

found_us.description: How your user says they found this API, if they said.

use_case.description: What they will do with it, 3 to 1000 characters.

name: start_signup
